query:
SELECT 
  s.id as staff_id,
  s.name as staff_name,
  s.email as staff_email,
  s.role as staff_role,
  s.organization_id,
  o.name as organization_name
FROM staff s
LEFT JOIN organizations o ON s.organization_id = o.id
ORDER BY o.name, s.name;
